# Events

Avro record schemas the engine emits — the business payload only (the CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers). Generated from `contracts/avro/`.

| Event | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`deposits.term_deposit.DepositConstituted`](./deposits.term_deposit.DepositConstituted.md) | The deposit is opened: principal, the rate-sheet-resolved TAN, and the AT_MATURITY schedule fixed at constitution. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| [`deposits.term_deposit.DepositMatured`](./deposits.term_deposit.DepositMatured.md) | The deposit matures and pays out: TotalPayout = Principal + NetInterest. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); no PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2). |
| [`deposits.term_deposit.InterestPaid`](./deposits.term_deposit.InterestPaid.md) | Interest is paid out — the coarse coupon/advance payout fact (the periodic/coupon variant, vs the single AT_MATURITY flow): NetInterest = GrossInterest − WithholdingTax conserved to the cent. PROMOTED to an integration event per [ADR-IC-017](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-017-integration-event-promotion-criterion.md) §P4 (coarse business fact; GL/accounting, notifications, and reporting react to it). The integration-relevant withholding AMOUNT rides here on withholding_tax_cents — the fine-grained WithholdingApplied/InterestAccrued accrual mechanics stay internal/store-only. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): deposit_id is an opaque reference, never depositor identity. |
| [`deposits.term_deposit.PersonalDataErasureRequested`](./deposits.term_deposit.PersonalDataErasureRequested.md) | GDPR Article 17 right-to-be-forgotten was exercised on this deposit: the subject's encryption key was crypto-shredded (IPiiKeyStore.DestroyKeyAsync, [ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P3), so all PII ciphertext under it is permanently unrecoverable; only non-personal structural fields remain queryable. Business payload only ([ADR-IC-002](../../integration_concepts/adrs/ADR-IC-002-schema-format-and-registry.md) §P5); CloudEvents envelope rides in Kafka headers, NOT here. No PII ([ADR-PC-004](../../product_concepts/adrs/ADR-PC-004-pii-crypto-shredding.md) §P2): subject_pseudonym is a salted one-way hash, NEVER the raw subject id. |
